Plan B: CAP4000 meets Tuesday/Thursday 10–11:40 a.m., leaving 20 minutes before work. I recommend B if that transition is practical because it avoids 8 a.m. classes. Neither fully meets your afternoon preference, which is a preference rather than a hard constraint.
